capabilities: wrap selected text in custom tags
trigger each wrapper with a hotkey
underline text with the default Ctrl-u/Cmd-u wrapper
extras: README only lists procedure headings without explaining the steps; Obsidian must be restarted after creating a wrapper before assigning its hotkey.
intentEvidence: Benature for obsidian-underline. This project is forked from his!
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define custom tag-wrapping commands bound to shortcuts for markup like underline or ruby.

relations.evidence: Benature for obsidian-underline. This project is forked from his!

summary: Hotkey-driven wrapper that encloses selected text in custom HTML tags, with underline, subscript, and ruby (furigana) as defaults.
